segment.source: Simulate evolution with agents that search for food, reproduce and pass on mutating genes. Inspect individual agents and analyze population and gene distribution in charts.
segment.target: Jijjiirama sanyii uumamoota nyaata barbaadan, ilmaan horan, jiinii jijjiiramu dabarsan fakkeessi. Uumamoota tokkoon tokkoon ilaali, baay'ina isaanii fi raabsa jiinii chaartii irratti qoradhu.
